metadata.description: Thinking and dev-workflow skill stack for indie hackers.

plugins.name: vibemaster
plugins.description: The full stack in one install: shaping, coding, dig and snapshot, a four-skill working loop

plugins.name: shaping
plugins.description: Shape unformed intent into something actionable: a grounded call, genuinely different creative directions, or a reviewable spec

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Development discipline from plan to green: red-green-refactor for new behaviour, green-to-green for pure refactors, verify before answering how-to-write-it questions, adversarial review before done

plugins.name: dig
plugins.description: Root-cause digging across any domain: reproduce, falsifiable hypotheses, single-variable evidence, fix only after the cause accounts for the symptom, delivered as issue.md

plugins.name: snapshot
plugins.description: Task-state snapshot: a document a fresh session can resume from, where decisions are trusted and facts re-verified on restore
